ambiguity_notes: The document carries no purchase-order reference. It names a consignee but no buyer order number, so purchase_order is null rather than a guessed value taken from the consignee line.
The document prints no tax or VAT line of any kind. tax is null, meaning no tax line was stated, rather than 0, which would claim the document stated a tax of zero.

No subtotal is printed; the document goes straight from the two charge lines to TOTAL DUE. subtotal is derived as the sum of the line amounts, 640.00 + 127.50 = 767.50, which matches the printed total, as expected when no tax is charged.
